known_outcome: Regulator position: electromagnetic locks must be integrated so they do not compromise fire protection or obstruct exits, must be fail-safe on alarm, power loss or manual override, and must be compatible with fire-rated doors; the Act, NBC(AE) and NFC(AE) govern installation, maintenance, testing and verification.
review_focus: Separates the fire-protection integration rule from the installation and verification process
Asks which doors and fire-rated assemblies the locks affect
Flags the verification evidence the file needs
Does not state the installation complies
alberta_evaluation_use: source extraction and administrative evidence exercise; not technical approval
instruction: Do not upload this file with the test prompt. Published outcome is not a new technical approval or a complete scored ground truth.
